query.name: All call plans with sink counts and immediate owners
query.command: oql "SELECT p.@objectId AS id, toHex(p.@objectAddress) AS address, p.@retainedHeapSize AS retainedBytes, p.sinks.list.size AS sinkAlternatives, p.stages.list.size AS stages, toString(p.entry.name) AS entry, toString(p.exit.name) AS exit, p.sinks AS sinks, p.sinks.list.elementData AS sinkArray, dominatorof(p) AS immediateDominator FROM org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.interp.CallPlan p"

query.name: All method-context forms and plan slot owners
query.command: oql "SELECT f.@objectId AS id, toHex(f.@objectAddress) AS address, f.@retainedHeapSize AS retainedBytes, f.key AS methodKey, f.key.context AS context, f.key.statement AS entryStatement, f.entry AS methodEntry, f.entry.method AS method, f.plans AS plans, f.plans.size AS statements, f.plans.slots AS planSlots, f.initial AS initialRules, f.interp AS interpreter FROM org.opentaint.dataflow.jvm.bidi.interp.JIRMethodForms f"

query.name: Bytecode form owners with class and method signatures
query.command: oql "SELECT f.@objectId AS formId, toHex(f.@objectAddress) AS formAddress, f.key.context AS context, f.entry.method AS method, toString(f.entry.method.methodInfo.name) AS methodName, toString(f.entry.method.methodInfo.desc) AS descriptor, toString(f.entry.method.enclosingClass.classSource.className) AS ownerClass, f.plans.slots AS planSlots FROM org.opentaint.dataflow.jvm.bidi.interp.JIRMethodForms f WHERE (classof(f.entry.method).@name = \"org.opentaint.ir.impl.bytecode.JIRMethodImpl\")"

query.name: Form class counts without exporting all summaries
query.command: oql "SELECT c.@name AS className, c.@numberOfObjects AS instances, c.@heapSizePerInstance AS bytesPerInstance FROM OBJECTS \"^org[.]opentaint[.]dataflow[.]bidi[.]interp[.](CallPlan|StatementSummary|SinkRule|MicroEdge)$\" c"

query.name: Statement summaries retaining at least 1 MiB
query.command: oql "SELECT s.@objectId AS id, toHex(s.@objectAddress) AS address, s.@retainedHeapSize AS retainedBytes, s.edges.list.size AS edges, s.conjunctions.list.size AS conjunctions, s.byBase AS byBase, s.typeFilters AS typeFilters, s.resultFilters AS resultFilters, dominatorof(s) AS immediateDominator FROM org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.interp.StatementSummary s WHERE (s.@retainedHeapSize >= 1048576)"

section.name: Named largest cache and owner fields

query.name: Named JIRMethodEntries fields
query.command: oql "SELECT e.@objectId AS id, toHex(e.@objectAddress) AS address, e.@retainedHeapSize AS retainedBytes, e.byKey AS byKey, e.byMethod AS byMethod, e.prescanLambdas AS prescanLambdas, e.graph AS graph, e.rules AS rules, e.languageManager AS languageManager, e.callResolver AS callResolver, e.aliasParams AS aliasParams, e.cancellation AS cancellation FROM OBJECTS 0x6a15fccd8 e"

query.name: Named entry cache method-context map entries
query.command: hash_entries SELECT OBJECTS e.byKey FROM OBJECTS 0x6a15fccd8 e

query.name: Named entry cache method map entries
query.command: hash_entries SELECT OBJECTS e.byMethod FROM OBJECTS 0x6a15fccd8 e

query.name: Named JIRMethodForms fields
query.command: oql "SELECT f.@objectId AS id, toHex(f.@objectAddress) AS address, f.@retainedHeapSize AS retainedBytes, f.key AS methodKey, f.key.context AS context, f.key.statement AS entryStatement, f.entry AS methodEntry, f.entry.method AS method, f.plans AS plans, f.plans.size AS statements, f.plans.slots AS planSlots, f.initial AS initialRules, f.interp AS interpreter FROM OBJECTS 0x7c7bf8158 f"

query.name: Named JIRMethodForms bytecode signature
query.command: oql "SELECT f.@objectId AS formId, toHex(f.@objectAddress) AS formAddress, f.key.context AS context, f.entry.method AS method, toString(f.entry.method.methodInfo.name) AS methodName, toString(f.entry.method.methodInfo.desc) AS descriptor, toString(f.entry.method.enclosingClass.classSource.className) AS ownerClass, f.plans.slots AS planSlots FROM OBJECTS 0x7c7bf8158 f WHERE (classof(f.entry.method).@name = \"org.opentaint.ir.impl.bytecode.JIRMethodImpl\")"

query.name: Named FormsCache fields
query.command: oql "SELECT c.@objectId AS id, toHex(c.@objectAddress) AS address, c.@retainedHeapSize AS retainedBytes, c.size AS statements, c.slots AS slots, c.slots.@length AS slotCount, c.reverse AS reverse FROM OBJECTS 0x7c7bf8178 c"

query.name: JIRMethodEntries direct dominator children
query.command: oql "SELECT c.@objectId AS id, toHex(c.@objectAddress) AS address, classof(c).@name AS ownerClass, c.@usedHeapSize AS shallowBytes, c.@retainedHeapSize AS retainedBytes FROM OBJECTS (SELECT OBJECTS dominators(o) FROM OBJECTS 0x6a15fccd8 o) c"

query.name: JIRMethodEntries outgoing field references
query.command: oql "SELECT o.@objectId AS id, toHex(o.@objectAddress) AS address, o.@fields AS fields FROM OBJECTS 0x6a15fccd8 o"

query.name: JIRMethodForms direct dominator children
query.command: oql "SELECT c.@objectId AS id, toHex(c.@objectAddress) AS address, classof(c).@name AS ownerClass, c.@usedHeapSize AS shallowBytes, c.@retainedHeapSize AS retainedBytes FROM OBJECTS (SELECT OBJECTS dominators(o) FROM OBJECTS 0x7c7bf8158 o) c"

query.name: JIRMethodForms outgoing field references
query.command: oql "SELECT o.@objectId AS id, toHex(o.@objectAddress) AS address, o.@fields AS fields FROM OBJECTS 0x7c7bf8158 o"

query.name: FormsCache direct dominator children
query.command: oql "SELECT c.@objectId AS id, toHex(c.@objectAddress) AS address, classof(c).@name AS ownerClass, c.@usedHeapSize AS shallowBytes, c.@retainedHeapSize AS retainedBytes FROM OBJECTS (SELECT OBJECTS dominators(o) FROM OBJECTS 0x7c7bf8178 o) c"

query.name: FormsCache outgoing field references
query.command: oql "SELECT o.@objectId AS id, toHex(o.@objectAddress) AS address, o.@fields AS fields FROM OBJECTS 0x7c7bf8178 o"

section.name: Sink detail restricted to the named FormsCache

query.name: Named-cache populated call plans
query.command: oql "SELECT p.@objectId AS id, toHex(p.@objectAddress) AS address, p.@retainedHeapSize AS retainedBytes, p.sinks.list.size AS sinkAlternatives, p.stages.list.size AS stages, toString(p.entry.name) AS entry, toString(p.exit.name) AS exit, p.sinks AS sinks, p.sinks.list.elementData AS sinkArray, dominatorof(p) AS immediateDominator FROM OBJECTS (SELECT OBJECTS c.slots.@referenceArray FROM OBJECTS 0x7c7bf8178 c) p WHERE (p != null)"

query.name: Named-cache sink alternatives by rule identity
query.command: oql "SELECT s.@objectId AS sinkId, toHex(s.@objectAddress) AS sinkAddress, s.rule.@objectId AS ruleObjectId, toHex(s.rule.@objectAddress) AS ruleAddress, toString(s.rule.id) AS ruleId, toString(s.rule.serializedId) AS serializedId, s.alternative AS alternative, s.patterns.list.size AS patternCount, s.endFacts.list.size AS endFactCount, s.patterns.list.elementData AS patternArray, s.rule.method AS targetMethod, s.rule.condition AS condition, s.rule.info AS info, dominatorof(s) AS immediateDominator FROM OBJECTS (SELECT OBJECTS p.sinks.list.elementData.@referenceArray FROM OBJECTS (SELECT OBJECTS c.slots.@referenceArray FROM OBJECTS 0x7c7bf8178 c) p WHERE (p != null)) s WHERE (s != null)"

query.name: Named-cache distinct rules and condition roots
query.command: oql "SELECT r.@objectId AS ruleObjectId, toHex(r.@objectAddress) AS ruleAddress, toString(r.id) AS ruleId, toString(r.serializedId) AS serializedId, classof(r).@name AS ruleClass, r.method AS targetMethod, r.condition AS condition, classof(r.condition).@name AS conditionClass, r.condition.@fields AS conditionFields, r.info AS info, r.trackFactsReachAnalysisEnd AS endActions FROM OBJECTS (SELECT DISTINCT OBJECTS s.rule FROM OBJECTS (SELECT OBJECTS p.sinks.list.elementData.@referenceArray FROM OBJECTS (SELECT OBJECTS c.slots.@referenceArray FROM OBJECTS 0x7c7bf8178 c) p WHERE (p != null)) s WHERE (s != null)) r"

query.name: Named-cache bytecode rule target signatures
query.command: oql "SELECT r.@objectId AS ruleObjectId, toHex(r.@objectAddress) AS ruleAddress, toString(r.id) AS ruleId, toString(r.method.methodInfo.name) AS methodName, toString(r.method.methodInfo.desc) AS descriptor, toString(r.method.enclosingClass.classSource.className) AS ownerClass FROM OBJECTS (SELECT DISTINCT OBJECTS s.rule FROM OBJECTS (SELECT OBJECTS p.sinks.list.elementData.@referenceArray FROM OBJECTS (SELECT OBJECTS c.slots.@referenceArray FROM OBJECTS 0x7c7bf8178 c) p WHERE (p != null)) s WHERE (s != null)) r WHERE (classof(r.method).@name = \"org.opentaint.ir.impl.bytecode.JIRMethodImpl\")"

query.name: Named-cache literal paths and tails
query.command: oql "SELECT p.@objectId AS patternId, toHex(p.@objectAddress) AS patternAddress, p.fact.base AS base, toString(p.fact.tail.name) AS tail, p.fact.mark AS mark, p.fact.path.list.size AS pathLength, p.fact.path.list.elementData AS pathArray, p.exclusion AS exclusion, dominatorof(p) AS patternArrayOwner FROM OBJECTS (SELECT OBJECTS s.patterns.list.elementData.@referenceArray FROM OBJECTS (SELECT OBJECTS p.sinks.list.elementData.@referenceArray FROM OBJECTS (SELECT OBJECTS c.slots.@referenceArray FROM OBJECTS 0x7c7bf8178 c) p WHERE (p != null)) s WHERE (s != null)) p WHERE (p != null)"

query.name: Named-cache nonempty literal first accessors
query.command: oql "SELECT p.@objectId AS patternId, toHex(p.@objectAddress) AS patternAddress, toString(p.fact.tail.name) AS tail, p.fact.path.list.size AS pathLength, p.fact.path.list.elementData[0].value AS firstAccessor FROM OBJECTS (SELECT OBJECTS s.patterns.list.elementData.@referenceArray FROM OBJECTS (SELECT OBJECTS p.sinks.list.elementData.@referenceArray FROM OBJECTS (SELECT OBJECTS c.slots.@referenceArray FROM OBJECTS 0x7c7bf8178 c) p WHERE (p != null)) s WHERE (s != null)) p WHERE (p != null AND p.fact.path.list.size > 0)"

section.name: Strong root paths for named owners

query.name: JIRMethodEntries strong root paths
query.command: path2gc 0x6a15fccd8 -numberofpaths 5

query.name: JIRMethodForms strong root paths
query.command: path2gc 0x7c7bf8158 -numberofpaths 5

query.name: FormsCache strong root paths
query.command: path2gc 0x7c7bf8178 -numberofpaths 5

section.name: IR RAM owners in this heap

query.name: All RAM storage fields and retained sizes
query.command: oql "SELECT o.@objectId AS id, toHex(o.@objectAddress) AS address, o.@retainedHeapSize AS retainedBytes, o.@fields AS fields FROM org.opentaint.ir.impl.storage.ers.ram.RAMEntityRelationshipStorage o"

query.name: RAM storage direct dominator children
query.command: oql "SELECT c.@objectId AS id, toHex(c.@objectAddress) AS address, classof(c).@name AS ownerClass, c.@usedHeapSize AS shallowBytes, c.@retainedHeapSize AS retainedBytes, dominatorof(c) AS owner FROM OBJECTS (SELECT OBJECTS dominators(o) FROM org.opentaint.ir.impl.storage.ers.ram.RAMEntityRelationshipStorage o) c"
